t2.title: International travel beneficial for young people
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is international travel beneficial for young people?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
International travel has become more accessible to young people. I firmly believe traveling abroad offers significant benefits for personal development.

Firstly, travel broadens cultural horizons. Experiencing different customs, cuisines, and lifestyles helps young people appreciate global diversity. This understanding is invaluable in our interconnected world.

Secondly, traveling develops practical skills. Navigating unfamiliar places, managing budgets, and solving unexpected problems build independence and confidence. These experiences cannot be gained from books alone.

However, critics argue travel is expensive and may be financially irresponsible for young people. Additionally, tourism can harm local environments and communities.

Nevertheless, budget travel options exist, including hostels, work-exchange programs, and off-season travel. Responsible tourism practices can minimize negative impacts.

Furthermore, travel enhances career prospects. International experience and language skills impress employers and demonstrate adaptability.

In conclusion, international travel offers young people irreplaceable learning experiences. When done responsibly, it enriches lives and prepares youth for a globalized future.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear DreamTrips Team,


I'm writing to give you some feedback about my recent holiday that I booked through your agency. Overall, I was quite happy with the service. The organisation was good, and everything went according to plan. The flights and hotel were as promised.


However, I think the airport transfer could have been better. The driver was late, which was a bit stressful. In the future, maybe you could offer more information about the local area in your travel packages. For example, a list of good restaurants or things to do.


I would also be interested in seeing more destinations in South America. I'm planning another trip next year, and I'll definitely consider using DreamTrips again.


Sincerely,
t2.sampleB2:
Broadening Horizons: Why Young People Should Pack Their Bags

Have you ever wondered what really shapes a young person's character? For many, the answer lies far beyond the classroom – out in the wider world. In my opinion, international travel is one of the most valuable experiences a young person can have.

First and foremost, travelling abroad opens your eyes to different cultures. When you step out of your comfort zone and immerse yourself in unfamiliar customs, food and languages, you gain a fresh perspective that no textbook could ever provide. This kind of first-hand experience builds tolerance and understanding.

What is more, travel teaches priceless life skills. Managing a budget, finding your way around a foreign city and coping with the unexpected all help young people stand on their own two feet. Employers, too, value the independence and confidence that globe-trotting brings.

Of course, travel can be pricey, but budget options such as hostels and student exchanges make it achievable for almost anyone willing to plan ahead.

All things considered, international travel is well worth the effort. It broadens the mind and prepares young people for life in an increasingly connected world.
t2.uzSample:
Xalqaro sayohat yoshlar uchun yanada qulay bo'lib qoldi. Men xorijga sayohat qilish shaxsiy rivojlanish uchun sezilarli foyda beradi, deb qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, sayohat madaniy dunyoqarashni kengaytiradi. Turli urf-odatlar, oshxonalar va turmush tarzini boshdan kechirish yoshlarga global xilma-xillikni qadrlashga yordam beradi. Bu tushuncha o'zaro bog'liq dunyomizda beqiyosdir.

Ikkinchidan, sayohat amaliy ko'nikmalarni rivojlantiradi. Notanish joylarda yo'l topish, byudjetni boshqarish va kutilmagan muammolarni hal qilish mustaqillik va ishonchni mustahkamlaydi. Bu tajribalarni faqat kitoblardan olish mumkin emas.

Biroq, tanqidchilar sayohat qimmat ekanligini va yoshlar uchun moliyaviy jihatdan mas'uliyatsizlik bo'lishi mumkinligini ta'kidlaydilar. Bundan tashqari, turizm mahalliy muhit va jamiyatlarga zarar etkazishi mumkin.

Shunga qaramay, arzon sayohat variantlari mavjud, jumladan, xostellar, ish almashish dasturlari va mavsumdan tashqari sayohat. Mas'uliyatli turizm amaliyotlari salbiy ta'sirlarni kamaytirishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, sayohat ish topish imkoniyatlarini oshiradi. Xalqaro tajriba va til bilish qobiliyati ish beruvchilarga ta'sir qiladi va moslashuvchanlikni namoyish etadi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, xalqaro sayohat yoshlarga o'rnini bosib bo'lmaydigan ta'lim tajribalarini taqdim etadi. Mas'uliyat bilan amalga oshirilganda, u hayotni boyitadi va yoshlarni globallashgan kelajakka tayyorlaydi.

Biroq, menimcha, aeroport transferi yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin edi. Haydovchi kech qoldi, bu biroz stressli bo'ldi. Kelajakda, ehtimol, siz sayohat paketlaringizda mahalliy hudud haqida ko'proq ma'lumot bera olasiz. Masalan, yaxshi restoranlar yoki qilinadigan ishlar ro'yxati.


Men Janubiy Amerikada ko'proq yo'nalishlarni ko'rishga ham qiziqardim. Men kelasi yilga yana bir sayohatni rejalashtiryapman va DreamTripsdan yana foydalanishni albatta o'ylab ko'raman.

t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli DreamTrips jamoasi,


Men yaqinda sizning agentligingiz orqali bron qilgan ta'til paketiga oid fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, men tashkiliy ishlaridan qoniqdim. Sayohat rejasi yaxshi tuzilgan edi va turar joy e'lon qilingan standartlarga javob berdi. Transferlar odatda o'z vaqtida bo'lib, silliq va yoqimli tajribaga hissa qo'shdi.


Biroq, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, jo'nashdan oldingi aloqa darajasini oshirish mumkin. Men vizaga oid talablar va mahalliy urf-odatlar haqida batafsilroq ma'lumot foydali bo'lishini his qildim. Ikkinchidan, kiritilgan ekskursiyalar yoqimli bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, ular biroz shoshilinchdek tuyuldi. Har bir joyda ko'proq vaqt ajratish tajribani sezilarli darajada yaxshilagan bo'lardi.


Kelajakka nazar tashlasak, DreamTrips kompaniyasining yanada ixtisoslashgan sarguzasht sayohat paketlarini, ehtimol, ekoturizm yoki madaniy integratsiyaga qaratilgan holda taklif qilishini ko'rishga qiziqardim. Barqaror sayohat uchun variantlarni taklif qilish ham sayohatchilarning o'sib borayotgan segmentiga yoqadi. Ushbu fikr-mulohazalarni bildirish imkoniyati uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the travel agency. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear DreamTrips Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your travel agency. I was extremely satisfied with my holiday package. The hotel accommodation was excellent, and the guided tours were wonderfully organized. Your agent was incredibly helpful in customizing the itinerary to my preferences. However, I have some suggestions. The airport transfers were slightly delayed, causing some inconvenience. Additionally, the travel insurance options weren't explained clearly. I would appreciate more adventure travel packages for active travelers. Eco-tourism options would attract environmentally conscious clients. Also, a mobile app with real-time updates would enhance the travel experience. Overall, DreamTrips provided a memorable vacation. Yours sincerely, Javohir Tojiyev
t12.sampleA1:
Hi DreamTrips!


My holiday was good. Hotel good. Tours good. I like beach. More beach please. Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Hi DreamTrips,


Thank you for my holiday. It was good. The hotel was nice and the food was good too. But the bus was late. I was sad. I want to go to Italy next time. And I want a bigger room because my room was small. Thank you.


Bye,


Javohir Tojiyev
t12.sampleB1:
Dear DreamTrips Team,


Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my holiday. It was mostly good. The hotel was very nice and the location was perfect. The tours were also interesting, but sometimes they were too crowded.


I think you should offer more trips to smaller towns. Also, it would be good if you had more information about the local food. I also think the prices for the extra activities were a bit too high.


Overall, I enjoyed my holiday. Thank you again.


Sincerely,
Javohir Tojiyev
t12.sampleB2:
Dear DreamTrips Team,

Thank you for reaching out to ask about my recent holiday package. On the whole, I was delighted with the service your agency provided, and I would like to share a few thoughts.

To begin with, the trip was superbly organised. The accommodation lived up to expectations, and the guided tours ran like clockwork. Your staff went out of their way to tailor the itinerary to my needs, which I greatly appreciated.

That said, there is room for improvement. The airport transfer was slightly delayed, and the information about travel insurance could have been clearer.

Looking ahead, I would love to see more eco-tourism packages and a mobile app offering real-time updates. These additions would take your service to the next level.

Yours sincerely,
Dilnoza Karimova

Ehtimol, har bir manzil uchun maxsus batafsil qadoqlash ro'yxatini taqdim etish ham qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'lishi mumkin.


Ushbu kichik kamchiliklarga qaramay, men ajoyib sayohat qildim va uni tashkil etishda jamoangizning sa'y-harakatlarini qadrlayman.


Hurmat bilan,
Javohir Tojiyev
